007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.Session;
010
011/**
012 * Sample for calling {@link Session#explainsql(String)}.
013 *
014 * <p>This sample delegates to {@link SessionNarrateSample} to create a
015 * {@link Session}, execute the {@code explainsql} session operation, and print
016 * the generated explanation.</p>
017 *
018 * <p>To run this sample with prompts such as {@code how many customers}, ensure
019 * the profile object list contains tables that match the prompt. For example,
020 * if the profile object list references the Oracle sample schema objects
021 * {@code SH.CUSTOMERS} and {@code SH.COUNTRIES}, ensure the {@code SH} schema
022 * is installed and visible to {@code SELECTAI_DB_USER}. The {@code SH} schema
023 * is not guaranteed to exist in every Oracle Autonomous AI Database or Oracle
024 * Database instance.</p>
025 *
026 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
027 * <ul>
028 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
029 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
030 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
031 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME</li>
032 * </ul>
033 *
034 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
035 * <ul>
036 *   <li>SELECTAI_SESSION_PROMPT_1 - session prompt. Defaults to a sample prompt.</li>
037 *   <li>SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_TITLE - conversation title.</li>
038 *   <li>SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_DESCRIPTION - conversation description.</li>
039 *   <li>SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_RETENTION_DAYS - retention period. Defaults to {@code 7}.</li>
040 *   <li>SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_LENGTH - conversation length. Defaults to {@code 20}.</li>
041 * </ul>
042 *
043 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
044 * <pre>{@code
045 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
046 * }</pre>
047 *
048 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
049 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
050 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
051 * <pre>{@code
052 * mvn clean install
053 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
054 * }</pre>
055 *
056 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
057 * <pre>{@code
058 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
059 *   -d samples/out \
060 *   samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/profile/SessionExplainSqlSample.java
061 * }</pre>
062 *
063 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
064 * <pre>{@code
065 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
066 *   com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile.SessionExplainSqlSample
067 * }</pre>
068 *
069 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
070 * read when run from a terminal.</p>
071 */
072public final class SessionExplainSqlSample {
073    private SessionExplainSqlSample() {
074    }
075
076    public static void main(String[] args) {
077        SessionNarrateSample.run("explainsql");
078    }
079}
